findings.question: Q1 AUTHORITY+TERMS (web-verified)
findings.evidence: Plan §3 bullet: 'FINRA describes the data as free for non-commercial use, subject to its current terms and attribution requirements.' WEB VERIFICATION 2026-09-15 (evidence: research/control/stocks_ng4_run/audits/evidence/finra_terms_snapshot_2026-09-15.txt): (a) FREE ANONYMOUS DOWNLOAD VERIFIED — https://cdn.finra.org/equity/regsho/daily/CNMSshvol20250915.txt and CNMSshvol20260911.txt both HTTP 200 text/plain with no key/login (sha256 37ad9c5c... / a8dc4e94...). (b) BUT the operative FINRA Website Terms of Use (https://www.finra.org/terms-of-use, 'Last modified: November 9, 2023', which by its own scope covers 'the FINRA.ORG site, including all of its content') permit only 'your own non-commercial personal or professional use' SUBJECT TO Restrictions, and the Restrictions contain: (m) no use of any portion of the FINRA Website 'in conjunction with any machine learning ... predictive analytics or other artificial intelligence ... program, including ... a model, algorithm, or process that is designed to predict trades for or within an individual portfolio' — the exact intended use of this cycle; (d) no 'develop or create a database of data using the FINRA Website, except as expressly permitted by any other terms of use on the FINRA Website'; (e) no 'process to monitor or copy the FINRA Website in bulk, or ... any data mining, scraping or harvesting tools (including robots) ... or similar data-gathering or extraction tools'; (g) no 'voluminous, excessive, or repetitive requests'. (c) NO permissive data-specific terms were locatable: https://www.finra.org/finra-data/terms-of-use is 404; the only published 'non-commercial' sentence found (site template: 'FINRA Data provides non-commercial use of data, specifically the ability to save data views and create and manage a Bond Watchlist') is scoped to login features, not bulk file download. (d) The plan's 'attribution requirements' claim is UNVERIFIED — no attribution clause found in the operative terms retrieved; the formatting-guide PDF was NOT_RUN (network timeout). (e) The F5 census design (measure 2018-08-01 through latest completed trade date ≈ 2,000+ programmatic daily-file retrievals into a committed census/digest database) is precisely the activity (d)/(e)/(g) address; finra.org additionally returns HTTP 403 to plain-curl HTML access, showing active enforcement of automated-access restrictions on its web estate. The plan's own F1 gate is fail-closed ('Ambiguous or incompatible terms => terminal close, not an inferred PASS') and would fire — but §3 as written carries a premise sentence the publisher's own terms contradict, so P0 would open under a false authority characterization and F1's verdict formation would be anchored to a wrong prior.
findings.recommendation: REFUSED as written; remediable before re-audit: (1) rewrite the §3 terms bullet to state the verified facts verbatim — anonymous free download confirmed; operative Terms of Use (2023-11-09) contain Restrictions (d)/(e)/(f)/(g)/(m) that on plain reading conflict with bulk census retrieval and with predictive-model use; no permissive data-specific terms locatable; attribution requirement not located; (2) extend F1 to require a written clause-by-clause compatibility verdict quoting (d)/(e)/(f)/(g)/(m), with AMBIGUOUS => terminal close and any non-terminal reading routed to an explicit OWNER decision recorded in a frozen artifact BEFORE registration/P0 dispatch; (3) scope F2/F5 retrieval volume and pacing against (g) explicitly (throttled, incremental, session-bounded) or predeclare census-scale as blocked pending owner direction; (4) drop or substantiate the 'attribution requirements' phrase (e.g. from the formatting guide, which must be retrieved and pinned). Plan §12 step 3 (remediate every HIGH/CRITICAL) is the preregistered path; V10/V11/V15/V17 precedent: refusal -> remediation amendment -> re-audit.

findings.question: Q4 PIT/REVISIONS (post-census revision consequence)
findings.evidence: FINRA's own page (verified): 'in rare instances, FINRA may need to update a file on a subsequent day ... will identify the updated file as Updated.' The plan handles detection (F2 two-retrieval mutation probe; F4 vintage identity; F8 rerun 'or explicitly identify a source revision') but never preregisters the CONSEQUENCE when a revision lands after the P0 census is committed and folds are frozen: whether the frozen fold boundaries and F7 counts are immutable (revision annotated, census stands as-of freeze) or the census must re-run (and if so, whether re-freezing after D2 numbers exist is forbidden per P-15/P-21). The F2 mutation probe is also only 3 canary dates x 2 retrievals against a ~2,000+ session census, so silent mid-history revisions are plausible; the census bytes themselves have no preregistered revision window.
findings.recommendation: Preregister in P0 (before D2): (i) census freeze = point-in-time as-of commit, later source revisions NEVER re-open fold boundaries or F7 counts; (ii) a declared revision-cutoff before S/E, with a detected revision's handling (annotate-and-keep vs exclude-window) fixed in writing; (iii) optionally widen the F2 mutation probe or add a deterministic re-digest pass over already-captured raw bytes as part of F8.

findings.question: Q3 SCIENCE (C7 exclusion rule freeze timing)
findings.evidence: Plan §5: 'If facility composition cannot be compared consistently across schema regimes, the affected window is excluded by the preregistered rule or the family dies.' The preregistered rule's freeze point (P0 census commit, alongside fold boundaries) and owner are unspecified; a rule choosable after D2 composition diagnostics exist is window-shoppable in the revive direction. Empirical context: canary B (2026-09-11) shows 11,628/12,274 rows with fractional volumes and 7,777+ multi-facility 'B,Q,N' codes vs all-integer single-file regimes in 2025 — the regime seam is real and the exclusion rule will plausibly bind.
findings.recommendation: Freeze the C7 exclusion rule textually in the same P0 commit as the fold boundaries (F7/F8 artifact set), before any D2 composition diagnostic runs.

hunting_summary: Audited adversarially against ledger (212-row table), FAMILY_FAILURES.jsonl (exactly 109 entries), MAP.md, LESSONS.md (P-1..P-21, Q-lessons), plans ng1-ng4 + data_fusion + v-plans, registry + events, pause packets, doctor output, the DISCOVERY_ONLY adapter and its tests/fixtures, and live FINRA web+CDN retrievals (evidence file pinned with digests). Q2 NOVELTY VERIFIED TRUE: no FINRA short-sale-volume / off-exchange short-volume / shvol observable is measured anywhere in the frozen ancestry — the only hits are the DISCOVERY_ONLY adapter (research/data_fusion/adapters/finra.py, authority DOCUMENTED_CANDIDATE, never wired to a scored family; ng1-ng3/v9-v11 worktrees contain only adapter/test/registry copies), data_fusion candidate-list mentions (plans/PLAN_data_fusion.md lines 70/168/266), PLAN_stocks_v5's 'requires an owner key/signup decision first' candidate line, and the external QuantPulse dossier's off-exchange print commentary (lineage note, not a measured family). It is not borrow fee.') with the adapter carrying a FINRA_SHORT_SALE_NOT_SHORT_INTEREST guard; nothing is smuggled. NOT a disguised rescue: C1 pins the dollar-volume-shock ancestor (SFV4-A5-H1, CONTROL_OUTEARNED_ANCHOR), C2/C4 pin activity/Amihud (CRYPTO-V11 ILLIQ-AMIHUD-28D, LIQEPIS), C3 pins momentum (STOCKS-FREE-V2, momentum_63s at 0.219), C9 is the standard stale/lag null, C10 the 0.20 ancestry bar on the frozen decision grid — every named ancestor is disclaimed in §2 and measured again at D2. Q3 SCIENCE: F1-F8 fail-closed ordering is sound and fixes the ng3 findings — fold boundaries frozen in P0 (F7) BEFORE D2 (ng3 F3 fixed), no returns/PnL/PF/Sharpe/drawdown in P0, D2 non-scored diagnostics only with enumerated PASS conditions, controls C1-C12, trial accounting §9, prewritten terminal outcomes §10 including BLOCKED_PRELAUNCH (ng3 F6 fixed). Empirical schema validation against live bytes: plan's 'known stale adapter' claim TRUE (discovery URL equity/regsho/nms/shrtYYYYMMDD vs current equity/regsho/daily/CNMSshvolYYYYMMDD.txt; integer-only parser + single-letter market validator + exact-6-column rule would each fail current files); 'compact dates and multi-facility market codes' TRUE (20250915|A|468928|276|799117|B,Q,N); 'current files may contain fractional share volumes' TRUE and load-bearing (11,628/12,274 decimal rows on 2026-09-11); invariant short_exempt<=short<=total holds in both canaries; files carry a row-count trailer. Q6: see F5. WHY REFUSED DESPITE ONE HIGH: the rubric reserves AUTHORIZED_WITH_FINDINGS for MEDIUM/LOW; the single HIGH (F1) sits on the plan's central authority premise — the §3 sentence about FINRA's terms is contradicted by the publisher's own operative Restrictions (m)/(d)/(e)/(g) as retrieved and pinned 2026-09-15, and the F5 census scale is exactly the restricted activity. The plan is remediable by rewriting §3 + extending F1 (its own fail-closed gate) and re-auditing; the refusal forces that remediation before registration per plan §12 step 3 and the V10/V11/V15/V17 precedent path. The other four findings are accuracy/robustness/hygiene items listed with remediation.
verdict_rationale: One HIGH finding (F1): the plan's §3 claim that FINRA describes the data as free for non-commercial use is not true as written — anonymous free download is verified, but the operative FINRA Website Terms of Use retrieved and pinned on 2026-09-15 (last modified 2023-11-09) permit non-commercial personal or professional use only subject to Restrictions that on plain reading prohibit (m) use in conjunction with any model/algorithm/process designed to predict portfolio trades (this cycle's exact purpose), (d) building a research database from the site, and (e)/(g) bulk programmatic copying and voluminous repetitive requests (the F5 census of ~2,000+ daily files); no permissive data-specific terms exist at any locatable URL (finra-data/terms-of-use 404; the site's only 'non-commercial use' sentence is scoped to saved views/Bond Watchlist login features), and the plan's 'attribution requirements' phrase is unverified. A plan whose source-authority characterization is contradicted by the publisher's own terms cannot be AUTHORIZED_WITH_FINDINGS (reserved for MEDIUM/LOW); it is REFUSED as written, with a concrete remediation path: rewrite §3 verbatim-true, extend F1 to a clause-by-clause compatibility verdict with owner routing before registration, scope/pace F5 retrieval or predeclare it blocked, and substantiate or drop the attribution claim — then re-audit. Q2 novelty, Q3 gate design, Q4 documented facts and Q5/Q6 conventions all verified TRUE against the frozen ancestry and live source bytes; the science and governance skeleton is strong and survives once the authority premise is made truthful.
